title: Glances: Your Ultimate System Dashboard Just Got Smarter!
contentMarkdown:
## 📝 Quick Summary: 
Glances is an open-source, cross-platform system monitoring tool written in Python. It provides real-time insights into CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, and container usage through a user-friendly dashboard. It supports remote monitoring via a web interface or API, and can export data to various formats or databases.

## 🔑 Key Takeaways

- ✅ Glances provides real-time, cross-platform system monitoring in a single, easy-to-read dashboard.

- ✅ It offers versatile usage modes: terminal (TUI), a responsive web interface (WebUI), and client/server capabilities.

- ✅ Monitor comprehensive data including CPU, memory, disk, network, processes, and containerized applications (Docker, LXC).

- ✅ Its new MCP server integration allows AI assistants to directly query system data, enabling intelligent automation.

- ✅ Glances is open-source, highly customizable, and simple to install, making it a powerful addition to any developer's toolkit.

## 🛠 Tech Stack
- ✅ Python


Hey fellow developers! Ever felt overwhelmed trying to keep an eye on all the moving parts of your system? Juggling multiple tools to check CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, and even your Docker containers can be a real headache. Well, what if I told you there's an incredibly powerful, yet delightfully simple, open-source tool that puts all this information, and much more, right at your fingertips? Meet Glances, and trust me, you're going to want to check this out!Glances is an absolute game-changer for anyone who needs real-time insights into their system's health. It's a cross-platform monitoring tool written in Python that provides a comprehensive, at-a-glance overview of your entire machine. We're talking CPU utilization, memory consumption, disk activity, network throughput, running processes, logged-in users, temperatures, and even fan speeds – all presented in a beautifully organized, easy-to-read dashboard. No more diving into multiple 'top' commands or 'htop' instances; Glances consolidates it all.What makes Glances truly stand out is its versatility. You can run it in a standalone terminal mode (TUI) for a quick overview, which is super handy for local debugging. But here's where it gets really cool: Glances also offers a full-fledged web interface! Just fire it up with 'glances -w', and you get a stunning, responsive web dashboard accessible from any browser. This is perfect for remote monitoring, allowing you to keep tabs on your servers from anywhere without needing SSH access for every little check. It even exposes a RESTful API, so you can integrate its data into your own applications or monitoring stacks.But wait, there's more! For those of us working with containers, Glances has fantastic built-in support for Docker and LXC. This means you can monitor your containerized applications right alongside your host system metrics, giving you a holistic view of your entire infrastructure. And in its latest versions, Glances is embracing the future with a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. This allows AI assistants like Claude or Cursor to directly query Glances for system information, opening up incredible possibilities for intelligent system management and automation. Imagine asking your AI what's consuming the most CPU on a specific server!The benefits for developers are immense. Glances saves you time by centralizing monitoring. It improves your workflow by providing clear, actionable data instantly. It helps you troubleshoot performance bottlenecks faster. And because it's open-source and based on an extensible architecture, you can even add your own plugins or export modules to tailor it precisely to your needs. Installation is a breeze, usually just a 'pip install glances', and you're good to go. If you're looking for an elegant, powerful, and easy-to-use system monitor, Glances should absolutely be in your toolkit. Go give it a star on GitHub and try it out!
